description: Checkout link to buy extra prepaid searches for one LAFU Search site, for shops that ran out but do not want to upgrade or turn on automatic extras. Packs (VAT 25.5 % included): 10,000 searches EUR 2, 1,000 voice searches EUR 1, 1,000 photo searches EUR 2. Pass kind (search, voice or photo) and packs (1 to 20) for a priced quote. Bought credit is added to the site, the unused part carries over until used and expires after 12 months.

packs.description: Number of packs for the price quote (default 1).

site.description: LAFU Search site: OMA id or domain. Optional when the account has one site.
